description: Everything needed to build one raidcom command: what it does, which models support it, whether it is read-only, destructive or asynchronous, each syntax form, every option with the number and kind of values it takes (and the words it accepts, where it accepts only a few), and examples. Call it before raidcom_build_command when you are unsure which options a command needs or which of its syntax forms fits the request.

command.description: Command name, e.g. "add lun" or "raidcom get ldev".

name: raidcom_describe_command
title: Describe a raidcom command
